notes.title: Major Update v2.0!
notes.notes:
I've changed alot of things in this update from your feedback so enjoy guys!


[b]***STORY MODE***[/b]

Rebalanced all of story mode, made alot of fights easier. 
Throw only and basic only conditions now you only need to win one round.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16986710/bc38d5943f188f0be2b638a41bb43a6432b259cd.jpg[/img]

All round conditions now have an icon above the opponents head making it alot more clear and easier to play.

[b]***SURVIVAL MODE***[/b]

You now only need to win one round, instead of two.

[b]***CHARACTER CHANGES***[/b]

GYEONG - Bullets are changed you can now do slow and fast shots

SIU - Bullets are changed you can now do slow and fast shots

MINSO - Panty shot does alot more damage now

REESE - Electric field does more damage now

**NEW MOVE - POWER ORB!***

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16986710/02e79de523eddc9ab97bf64c55e323f7df2b568b.jpg[/img]

Reese can now shoot orbs which electrocute the opponent!
Reduced Reese's ammo from 3 to 2 to compensate

YOHAN - Vials now cause dizzy

**NEW MOVE - SLIDE!***

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16986710/cdeb416a1c3f475cb8612df1aa55e4b488ebe561.jpg[/img]

Yohan can now do a slide attack, which makes him a much better character along with his vials doing dizzy damage

JAE - Bullet dodge is now Bullet deflect and can deflect bullets
       - Breakdance does alot more damage now

GUN - Clothesline does alot more damage now

HYUK - Machinegun has a slow and fast move


[b]***GAMEPLAY CHANGES***[/b]

I've changed all the walking and jumping values, it plays correctly now. This was due to the widescreen aspect ratio before.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16986710/ccccd168e55fca4f34c23af6f1f85c68a39756c5.png[/img]

Made more tweaks to the collision code

Removed the slowmo effect from bullets, dogs and pigeons


[b]***BACKGROUND CHANGES***[/b]

I've added more details and polish to certain backgrounds and theres a new technique applied to the far layer

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16986710/752d676bf9f371f0dd4e416e5209b8490f980c67.jpg[/img]

The new lower res far layer makes it easier to focus on the action, something I'm still working on

[b]***ACHIEVEMENTS CHANGES***[/b]

You now only need to get a 4hit combo instead of 7hits in arcade mode

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That's pretty much it guys, any problems ideas/suggestions let me know on the VG steam forums!

Enjoy!

PSD

notes.title: 1st update! New gun combat plus your suggestions!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.verdictguilty.com/logo.png[/img]

Hi Guys,

We've implemented some of your suggestions as promised. I've also improved the gun combat to play as it should do. Enjoy the update!

Suggestions implemented->

User : T*******ma
Suggestion : (Include Controller button prompts)

The game now displays button prompts if a controller is connected, otherwise it shows the keyboard prompts. As a bonus I've updated the move lists to show the correct buttons. You can still play with controller and keyboard and I added some other few fixes!


User : O****s
Suggestion : (Yohans vials are too strong)

Vial damage has been reduced, and Yohan's reload time increased.


User : Mc ******es
Suggestion : (Gun's barrel roll is too strong)

I've increased the dizzy time to compensate.


User : C****op
Suggestion : (Add reload text to hud if out of ammo)

Done! And works well too! Thanks.


New gun combat->

All guns now fire instantly, with reduced damage and increased reload times. However you can now implement gun moves into combos, for pretty devasting attacks.


Side note ***(I'd strongly recommend using the keyboard...for now)****

I've noticed that playing with a controller is incredibly harder at the moment, especially when trying to do specials and combos. If you want the full experience I'd recommend using the keyboard until I've fixed the issue in the next update. The controller still works fine, but I need to work on it more.


Thanks for everyones comments and suggestions,

Paul
